{{Quote|I am more afraid to fail than to die. Much is expected from the son of Chewbacca&mdash;he cannot be a coward.|translated=1|Lumpawarrump, to Chewbacca|<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />}}
'''Lumpawaroo''', also known as '''Waroo''', was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who emerged from the shadow of his famous [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to become a brave, talented, and powerful warrior within the [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] community on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Born '''Lumpawarrump''' in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and known as '''Lumpy''' throughout his [[Youngling/Legends|youth]], he was raised by his mother [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] and his grandfather [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] while Chewbacca served a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to and traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Lumpawarrump idolized his father and constantly dreamed of the elder Wookiee's adventures while Chewbacca was away. While gathering [[Wasaka berry/Legends|wasaka berries]] in Kashyyyk's dangerous [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] in preparation for Chewbacca's 200th [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]], a young Lumpawarrump hoped to be as brave as his father but ended up hiding, terrified, from the various creatures that lurked in the [[Tree/Legends|forest]]. Although his father rescued him and brought him [[Chewbacca's home|home]], the ordeal caused Lumpawarrump considerable trauma. Coupled with the absence of a father figure to help him grow into a brave young man, the experience turned Lumpawarrump into a shy and timid Wookiee who rarely left his home. Unless Chewbacca was around for Lumpawarrump to attempt to impress, he stayed away from danger and did not find his [[rrakktorr]], the eager and defiant strength of a male Wookiee's [[Heart/Legends|heart]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after Lumpawarrump's misadventure in the Shadowlands, he and his [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|family]] were [[Blockade of Kashyyyk (1 ABY)|visited]] by members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the Wookiee [[holiday]] [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. The Imperials were searching Kashyyyk for ties between its inhabitants and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and remained in Lumpawarrump's home for some [[Time/Legends|time]] before Chewbacca and Solo arrived to celebrate the holiday. Chewbacca and Solo helped [[Skirmish on Kashyyyk (Nagai invasion)|free]] Lumpawarrump and many other Wookiees from [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] at the hands of the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Ozrei N'takkilomandrife|Knife]] [[4 ABY/Legends|three years later]], and in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Lumpawarrump and Mallatobuck visited Chewbacca at his [[Chewbacca's quarters|apartment]] on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The three became tangled in an Imperial [[Skirmish in the secret Imperial detention center|scheme]] to destroy the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that Chewbacca and Solo served, and Lumpawarrump was kidnapped by several [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[underdweller]]s and taken to a [[secret Imperial detention center]] in the planet's [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]]. After his parents rescued him, the three Wookiees were able to prevent the underdwellers from unleashing a [[Zemex|nerve toxin]] at an upcoming New Republic governmental banquet.

In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], Lumpawarrump's coming-of-age [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|hrrtayyk ceremony]] was interrupted when Chewbacca, who was guiding his son through it, learned that Solo had been kidnapped by the [[Yevetha]]n [[Duskhan League]]. Lumpawarrump tagged along on the [[Mission to the Koornacht Cluster|rescue mission]] so that he might prove himself, and father and son stormed the Yevethan [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Pride of Yevetha'']] and rescued the [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] Solo. Lumpawarrump found his rrakktorr, passed his hrrtayyk, and earned his new name, Lumpawaroo, after receiving a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] wound in the [[Limb/Legends|leg]] and meeting it without flinching. Chewbacca was able to spend more time with Lumpawaroo over the next several years, but when the elder Wookiee was [[Destruction of Sernpidal|killed]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Lumpawaroo and his cousin [[Lowbacca]] pledged to take over Chewbacca's life debt to Solo. Solo delayed them for four years in order to grieve the loss of his best friend, but in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], they reaffirmed their convictions and attached themselves to Solo, although they ultimately served him for less than six years. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Solo and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] came to Kashyyyk to speak with the planet's [[Rock Council]], and Lumpawaroo guided them across [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]] for four days as they made their way to [[Council Rock]]. Lumpawaroo later crewed the Solos' [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and worked to extinguish forest fires that raged across Kashyyyk after an [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|orbital bombardment]] by the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]].

==Biography==
===Mischievous youth===
{{Quote|Hey, congratulations, Chewie! You're a dad!|Han Solo, to Chewbacca, upon discovering the newborn Lumpawarrump|<ref name="Rebel Dawn" />}}
The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Lumpawarrump was born<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Leland" /> in the [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] to [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], a teacher and caregiver who worked in a nearby village's [[nursery ring]]. Mallatobuck had recently [[Wedding of Chewbacca and Mallatobuck|wed]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] and co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and the [[Marriage/Legends|newlyweds]] had [[Reproduction/Legends|conceived]] Lumpawarrump during their honeymoon. Chewbacca had then left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with Solo, to whom he had sworn a Wookiee [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] of protection, and Lumpawarrump was born nearly one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] later. Chewbacca and Solo returned to Kashyyyk shortly thereafter while on a supply run to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and both were overjoyed to discover Mallatobuck holding the newborn Lumpawarrump in her Rwookrrorro home.<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> Chewbacca roared with pride as he realized that he had become a [[Parent/Legends|father]],<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' {{C|See "Chewbacca"}}</ref> and the new parents immediately began to discuss baby names.<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> They ultimately settled on Lumpawarrump, or "Lumpy" for short.<ref name="EGTC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' {{C|See "Chewbacca"}}</ref>

[[File:Wherethewhildthingsare.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lumpawarrump hunts for wasaka berries in the Shadowlands of Kashyyyk.]]
Chewbacca was unable to remain with his new son for long and quickly left with Solo for the Corporate [[Sector/Legends|Sector]],<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> but he returned to Kashyyyk as often as he could over the subsequent years to visit his [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|family]],<ref name="NEGTC" /><ref name="Chewie DB">{{DB|character|chewbacca|Chewbacca}}</ref> including a several-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long visit in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> Lumpawarrump, Mallatobuck, and Chewbacca's father [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] were designated as a [[Wookiee honor family]] and were looked after by Chewbacca's close friends on Kashyyyk. While Chewbacca and Solo roamed [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Lumpawarrump was raised on Kashyyyk by his mother and grandfather.<ref name="Chewie DB" /> Attichitcuk lived with Lumpawarrump and Mallatobuck in their [[Tree/Legends|treetop]] [[Chewbacca's home|dwelling]]<ref name="Itchy DB">{{DB|character|itchy|Attichitcuk}}</ref> and was content to live out his elder years playing with his [[Youngling/Legends|young]] grandson.<ref name="Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' {{C|In-game databank, see "Attichitcuk"}}</ref>

Circa 0 BBY,<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook">''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]''</ref><ref name="birth years">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}</ref> Chewbacca was on his way home to celebrate his 200th [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] with his family, and Mallatobuck began to plan a surprise party for her husband. Lumpawarrump was dismayed when she forbade him to venture into the dangerous [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of Kashyyyk's forest floor to gather [[Wasaka berry/Legends|wasaka berries]], an essential ingredient of Chewbacca's [[Wasaka-berry pudding|favorite dessert]], but he was cheered up when Attichitcuk told him a story of Chewbacca and Solo battling [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. Inspired, Lumpawarrump sneaked out of his house to hunt for wasaka [[Fruit/Legends|berries]] in the hope of becoming as heroic as his father. The young Wookiee was unable to find any berries near his house, and he began to cautiously descend a rope ladder into the jungle's lower levels. He soon lost his footing and tumbled down a [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr tree]] into the Shadowlands, landing in a swamp and attracting the attention of several creatures. Lumpawarrump was very frightened, but he ignored the creatures and continued to search for berries among the swamp's tree roots, confident that his father would not have give up if faced with a similar predicament.<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" />

When a furry ball-shaped [[Unidentified ball-shaped creature|creature]] lunged at him, Lumpawarrump abandoned his quest and dove into a hollow log. He remained there, shaking with fear, until he heard the sound of a passing [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Lumpawarrump poked his head out of the log and saw his father flying an [[explorer craft]] through the Shadowlands; Chewbacca had been sent to the swamps by Mallatobuck to search for their missing son. Lumpawarrump climbed into his father's craft but quickly began to cry, disheartened that he had failed to find any wasaka berries. As they sped toward their home, Chewbacca told his son that his persistence in the face of fear was a telltale sign of a hero, and Lumpawarrump immediately brightened. He avoided a scolding from his mother when they were greeted at their home by hundreds of Wookiees who had gathered for Chewbacca's surprise party. Along with Han Solo, the gathered Wookiees celebrated well into the night, dancing, playing games, eating Mallatobuck's [[Soufflé/Legends|soufflés]], and watching [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]].<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" />

===A Life Day to remember===
{{Quote|Lumpy. Itchy. Chewie. Malla. This day is for you. Have a wonderful celebration.|Saun Dann, to Lumpawarrump and his family on Life Day|<ref name="Holiday Special" />}}
In the following years, Chewbacca and Solo became key members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during its [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|struggle]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTC" /> Lumpawarrump's adventure in the Shadowlands become a family fable that further exaggerated the danger posed by the creatures in the Shadowlands with each retelling.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Leland Holiday">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM}}</ref> Lumpawarrump was at home with his mother and grandfather on the Wookiee [[holiday]] [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] as they prepared to receive Chewbacca and Solo for a celebration. Lumpawarrump happily ran through the house and played with a wooden model of an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]], but he was reprimanded by Mallatobuck for bothering his grandfather and for trying to sneak one of the [[Wookiee-ookiee]]s that she had baked. Mallatobuck assigned him the task of taking out the garbage; once outside, Lumpawarrump playfully walked along the top of the railing that surrounded his home's balcony before going back inside.<ref name="Holiday Special" />

[[File:Tumblingandbumbling.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lumpawarrump watches a holographic tumbling show on Life Day.]]
After he completed his task, Lumpawarrump was treated to a tabletop performance by some [[holographic tumbler]]s, which Attichitcuk turned on for the delighted young Wookiee. After the performance, his elation was interrupted by his mother's insistence that he clean dishes in the kitchen sink. When he finished with the dishes, an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (wallscreen)|Imperial officer]] appeared on the home's [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] and announced that the Empire had declared [[Blockade of Kashyyyk (1 ABY)|martial law]] on the planet due to suspected Rebel activity. Lumpawarrump grew worried and hid when he heard a knock on the front door, but the visitor was merely [[Saun Dann]], a Human [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] and a friend of the family. He brought Life Day gifts for all three Wookiees, including a [[mini-transmitter]] for Lumpawarrump. The young Wookiee rushed upstairs to his room to open the gift, but he raced down to the foyer even faster when he heard the sound of Solo's starship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], flying overhead. When he and Mallatobuck opened the front door, they were shocked to find two Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] pointing [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] at them.<ref name="Holiday Special" />

Seeking evidence of ties to the Rebellion, the stormtroopers entered the house along with<ref name="Holiday Special" /> a [[Unidentified Imperial technician|technician]] and an Imperial [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Blockade of Kashyyyk)|commander]].<ref name="EGTC" /> As the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] searched the home, the technician asked Lumpawarrump about his father's whereabouts, only to have his fingers bitten in response. Mallatobuck and Dann prevented him from striking Lumpawarrump, and Dann was soon told to leave by the Imperials. Lumpawarrump protested when the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] ordered his room to be searched, and when Attichitcuk attempted to block the trooper's path, the elderly Wookiee was thrown aside. The Commander then intervened and calmed a furious Mallatobuck down. The search proceeded, and Mallatobuck consoled her son by letting him watch a [[Unidentified Rebel cartoon|cartoon]] that featured Chewbacca, his Rebel companions, and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. When the cartoon caused him to scream, Lumpawarrump quickly changed the screen of his [[video book]] to display a simple game in order to fool the curious Commander. Although he enjoyed the cartoon, his dismay returned afterward when he discovered that the Imperials had beheaded his [[stuffed bantha]]. Alone in his room, Lumpawarrump cheered himself up by turning on his mini-transmitter and watching an [[instruction cassette]] that taught him how to assemble it.<ref name="Holiday Special" />

[[File:Lifedaycelebration.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Lumpawarrump celebrates Life Day with his family.]]
After Lumpawarrump followed the instructions given by the [[Amorphiian]]<ref name="Holiday Special" /> [[Dromboid]],<ref name="Bad Feeling">{{InsiderCite|106|I Have a Bad Feeling About This!}}</ref><ref name="Script">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsholidayspecial.com/text/script.htm|text=The Fourth Draft Script - 09/13/78|author=Kirkwood, SKot|archivedate=20061126191402}}</ref> he transmitted a "return to base" signal to the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer's]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The gambit worked, and the Commander departed the home with the technician and [[Unidentified stormtrooper (Blockade of Kashyyyk)|one trooper]], but, suspecting that Chewbacca was a Rebel, left the stormtrooper [[B4711]] behind to apprehend the Wookiee upon his return. When the "return to base" signal continued to chime, B4711 entered his room, discovered the tricky, and broke the device. Frightened, Lumpawarrump rushed outside and into the [[Limb/Legends|arms]] of Chewbacca, who had just arrived home. B4711 pointed his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] at the Wookiees, but Han Solo snuck up behind him and batted the rifle away. B4711 then tripped over a log and fell to the forest floor below. Lumpawarrump, Chewbacca, and Solo went inside for a joyous reunion, but Solo quickly left to ensure that the Imperials did not find the ''Millennium Falcon''.<ref name="Holiday Special" />

As Lumpawarrump and his family delighted in Chewbacca's presence, Dann returned; when an Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] appeared on the viewscreen and inquired about B4711, Dann convinced him that the stormtrooper had stolen some of Mallatobuck's food and fled. Dann then departed, and Lumpawarrump and his family donned red [[Life Day robes/Legends|robes]], gathered [[Life Day Orb/Legends|Life Day orbs]], and made their way to the celebratory [[Tree of Life/Legends|Tree of Life]] to enjoy Life Day among a large gathering of Wookiees. Solo and his companions [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] joined them, and Organa sang a [[A Day to Celebrate|song]]. Afterward, Lumpawarrump and his family returned home for a Life Day feast.<ref name="Holiday Special" /> At some point between 0 BBY and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Galaxies">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Family Bonds}}</ref><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Family Bonds|painting]] of them dressed in their Life Day robes was available in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Galaxies" />

{{Talesstart}}
At some point before or during [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Lumpawarrump drew a picture of a Wookiee surrounded by planets and [[Star/Legends|stars]] and gave it to Chewbacca. The picture was taped to an interior bulkhead of the ''Millennium Falcon''.<ref name="A Wookiee Scorned">{{Tales|10|A Wookiee Scorned!}}</ref>
{{Talesend}}

===Enslaved===
{{Dialogue|Chewbacca|Urf?|Calrissian|Now what?|Solo|That sounds like&hellip; It is! It's Lumpy, Chewbacca's son!|attr=Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian, and Han Solo discover Lumpawarrump in the hands of slavers|src=<ref name="Wookiee World">[[Star Wars (1977) 91|''Star Wars'' (1977) 91]]</ref>}}
In 4 ABY, Solo and Chewbacca participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which saw [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] and the remainder of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] fragmented. The Rebel Alliance was reorganized into the [[Alliance of Free Planets]].<ref name="NEC" /> However, the Empire's Wookiee slave trade was taken over early in 4 ABY by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Ozrei N'takkilomandrife]], known to the Wookiees as "Knife," who teamed up with Mallatobuck's traitorous brother [[Vargi]] and began to round up Wookiees as slaves.<ref name="Wookiee World" /> The Nagai were from the satellite galaxy [[Firefist]] and had dispatched Knife to create a slave trade that would distract the Alliance while the Nagai [[Nagai–Tof War|invaded]] the galaxy.<ref name="The Forgotten War">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref> When Vargi informed Knife of Chewbacca's status as a Wookiee hero, Knife kidnapped Lumpawarrump, Mallatobuck, and Attichitcuk, hoping to use them as bait and to capture Chewbacca himself.<ref name="Wookiee World" />

[[File:Alumpyworld.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lumpawarrump greets his father while a captive of the Nagai Knife.]]
Chewbacca, along with Solo and their friend [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], soon arrived on Kashyyyk for a visit and were brought to Chewbacca's home by Knife and Vargi under the pretense of waiting for Mallatobuck to arrive. Knife's other Wookiee companions brought Lumpawarrump and Mallatobuck inside at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]], fitted Chewbacca with [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]], led all three captives to a nearby [[Rwookrrorro Spaceport|spaceport]], and left Solo and Calrissian under guard inside the home. The two Humans escaped, however, and Calrissian managed to free Lumpawarrump, his mother, and his grandfather. The four of them made their way to the starship that Chewbacca and several other Wookiee captives were boarding and found Chewbacca and Solo in a [[Skirmish on Kashyyyk (Nagai invasion)|brawl]] with Vargi. Calrissian fired his blaster at a [[Knife/Legends|combat knife]] that Knife was preparing to throw at Chewbacca, who then overpowered a distracted Vargi as his fellow captives rose up against Knife's Wookiee allies. Knife fled the planet in the ''[[Cobra]]'', Calrissian's starship, but his attempts to subjugate the Wookiees had failed.<ref name="Wookiee World" /> The Nagai's invasion of the galaxy was later averted by the Alliance of Free Planets when the two groups joined forces to defeat the Nagai's oldest enemy, the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]].<ref name="Marvel 107">[[Star Wars (1977) 107|''Star Wars'' (1977) 107]]</ref>

As Lumpawarrump grew up, his love for his father grew into an idolization. He often played as Chewbacca in the [[Hologame/Legends|hologame]] "[[Galactic Rebels]]" and constantly boasted to his peers that he was as strong as his father. His friends grew bored of his attitude, and his enemies challenged him to back up his words. Lumpawarrump often came home [[Blood/Legends|bloodied]] after the resulting fights and grew more insular as a result.<ref name="A Forest Apart">''[[A Forest Apart]]''</ref> Coupled with lingering trauma from his childhood trip to the Shadowlands,<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> these experiences caused the young Wookiee to rarely leave home,<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /><ref name="A Forest Apart" /> content to remain close to his house and to the [[Wookiee nursery ring|Rwookrrorro nursery ring]] where young Wookiees were raised. Mallatobuck and Attichitcuk did not encourage Lumpawarrump to take part in the unstructured rough-and-tumble play that occurred in the nursery ring, and as such, he did not develop the fearlessly headlong fighting style that was characteristic of Wookiee males. Lumpawarrump did not become close friends with other Wookiees,<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> and he preferred to stay at home playing hologames and dreaming of his father's adventures.<ref name="A Forest Apart" />

===His father's son===
{{Quote|What's this? If you are angry, at least have the courage to look me in the eyes.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''I'm not angry. I just wanted to show you. That's all.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Show me?''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''That I can handle myself. Like you and Han.|translated=1|Chewbacca and Lumpawarrump, while inside a secret Imperial detention center|<ref name="A Forest Apart" />}}
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Chewbacca and Solo were serving the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], which had succeeded the Alliance of Free Planets, and Lumpawarrump and Mallatobuck visited Chewbacca at his [[Chewbacca's quarters|home]] on the New Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Lumpawarrump gathered several souvenirs during his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]], and, during the family's final [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] together, Mallatobuck informed Chewbacca of their son's troubles with other young Wookiees. The two resolved that Lumpawarrump would spend one or two years with Chewbacca in order to overcome his timidity and learn that his father's life was not one constant holoadventure. As they privately came to their decision, Lumpawarrump left his father's quarters after hearing noises in the adjacent [[Solos' apartment|apartment]] of Solo and Leia Organa Solo, the former smuggler's new wife. Lumpawarrump discovered the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[underdweller]] [[Rath]] within, who overpowered him and drew a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] on the young Wookiee. Rath then forced Lumpawarrump to rifle through Organa Solo's belongings in search of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. When Chewbacca and Mallatobuck entered the apartment in search of their son, they located and threatened Rath, who did not understand their native [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] tongue. Lumpawarrump, eager for an opportunity to impress his father, charged at Rath, but his foe easily pulled him into a chokehold and retrieved the datapad from a garment bag on the floor.<ref name="A Forest Apart" />

[[File:Lumpawaroo-TheSWHolidaySpecial.jpg|thumb|left|225px|A young Lumpawarrump]]
Rath prepared to pull Lumpawarrump into the hole in the wall through which he had entered, and claimed that he would return the young Wookiee in three [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] if Chewbacca and Mallatobuck walked away. Lumpawarrump's parents ignored him and ordered their son to attempt to escape; they then charged at Rath just as Lumpawarrump began to struggle. Rath lost both Lumpawarrump and his blaster in the ensuing chaos, but he escaped through the hole into a service run with the datapad. Chewbacca ascertained that Rath had been a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in search of valuable information contained on the datapad, and he prepared to call [[New Republic Security Force|New Republic Security]] as he praised his son for slowing the spy down. Lumpawarrump, enthused by the compliment and convinced that he was in the middle of a "Galactic Rebels"&ndash;like scenario, leaped into the hole in the wall. He disobeyed his parents' commands to stop and instructed them to meet him at the bottom of the service run as he climbed down after Rath. Chewbacca and Mallatobuck were too large to fit into the hole and thus made their way to its drop-off point in the [[Level 2012 Physical Plant]] below.<ref name="A Forest Apart" />

At the bottom of the service run, Lumpawarrump observed Rath arguing with two of his underdweller companions about the approval of their [[It (IT-3 Interrogator)|boss]]. When they stated that they had only ten hours to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] the datapad and hurried away, Lumpawarrump began to follow a trail of blood left by Rath rather than wait for his parents. He left distinctive footprints in the blood puddles so that they could track him, however. When Rath and his companions entered a clean-out door on an overpressure pipe, Lumpawarrump grabbed the left feet of the last two to enter and held on, hoping to take them [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. Chewbacca and Mallatobuck caught up to him at that point, but desperate blaster shots fired from Rath and his companions startled Lumpawarrump, caused him to let go of the feet and to stumble away from the pipes. After Chewbacca ensured that their enemies were gone, he and Mallatobuck scolded Lumpawarrump for rushing ahead without them. Lumpawarrump told his parents what he had overheard, and as they began to plan their next move, a member of Rath's group reached out from the clean-out door, grabbed Lumpawarrump, and drew him inside the pipe and away from his parents.<ref name="A Forest Apart" />

Lumpawarrump was brought into an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] where Rath's boss, an Imperial [[IT-3 Interrogator]] droid nicknamed "It," was waiting. The droid predicted that Chewbacca and Mallatobuck would follow them to the Imperial [[Secret Imperial detention center|detention center]] for which they were headed, and it instructed its underlings to hold the young Wookiee in the center's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] until his parents arrived. They then discussed a [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve toxin]] called [[zemex]]. After arriving at the hangar, several of the underdwellers attempted to hold the young Wookiee still. Lumpawarrump put up a fight, however, breaking noses and dislocating jaws of his captors. His parents were close behind him, and Mallatobuck chased the underdwellers off. With the knowledge that a trap had been set for them, Lumpawarrump tried to drag his parents deeper into the complex, but they interrupted his attempts to warn them and refused to budge until laser [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]] appeared and [[Skirmish in the secret Imperial detention center|fired]] at them. Lumpawarrump and Mallatobuck raced through a security door and into a group of underdwellers; Lumpawarrump grabbed the arms of two of them and pointed them to the floor in an effort to prevent them from accurately firing their blasters. Mallatobuck bent bodies in wrong directions, and Chewbacca entered close behind them and finished off the group with a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster]].<ref name="A Forest Apart" />

The three found themselves in a prisoner-processing area, and Chewbacca blasted their way into an adjacent guard station before asking Lumpawarrump what he had learned while in the underdwellers' custody. When Lumpawarrump told them about the interrogator droid, Chewbacca began to search for a way to escape that would allow them to avoid the guns of the turrets. When he climbed a ladder into a command deck overlooking the hangar, he discovered [[ISBy]], an [[ISB-120]] [[Slicer droid/Legends|slicer droid]], working on a datapad. Lumpawarrump wanted to rush up behind Chewbacca and subdue it, but a firm reprimand from his father dampened his resolve. Lumpawarrump and Mallatobuck waited as Chewbacca entered the command deck, but they eventually followed him up when they heard the sound of blasterfire. They found the droid and the datapad destroyed, Rath [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]], and a female [[Unidentified underdweller|underdweller]] pointing a blaster at Chewbacca. As they silently approached, the underdweller was contacted by "It," and the ensuing conversation revealed that the destroyed datapad was a decoy. Mallatobuck snuck up behind the underdweller and thieved her weapon, and Lumpawarrump used Rath's blaster to fire three shots at a desk to convince "It" that the underdweller had shot the three Wookiees. "It" ended the conversation, and Chewbacca knocked the underdweller unconscious.<ref name="A Forest Apart" />

[[File:Familyfeast.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Lumpawarrump sought to be as heroic as his father during their adventure on Coruscant.]]
Chewbacca and Mallatobuck were ready to escape, but when Lumpawarrump mentioned that he had overheard the underdwellers talking about zemex, Chewbacca realized that they were planning to release it at an upcoming governmental banquet, about which Organa Solo's datapad had given them information. The Wookiees spotted the underdwellers loading the toxin into an airspeeder in the hangar, and Lumpawarrump offered to enter the hangar and act as bait while his parents attacked. With no better idea of his own, Chewbacca reluctantly approved, and Lumpawarrump climbed out of a hole that had earlier been blasted in the command deck and down into the hangar. After he was spotted, his parents rushed into the hangar from the corridor and downed several distracted underdwellers with their blasters. The three Wookiees cut off the return fire by taking shelter behind a row of zemex canisters; Chewbacca then lifted a canister and began to make his way to the airspeeder, with Lumpawarrump and Mallatobuck close behind him.<ref name="A Forest Apart" />

Terrified of hitting the canister with their blaster bolts, the underdwellers fled into the corridor when Mallatobuck opened fire at them. "It," damaged from the earlier [[Lightfight|firefight]], [[Repulsorlift/Legends|floated]] over to the Wookiees and attacked Chewbacca with its [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]], but Chewbacca and Mallatobuck were able to destroy it and retrieve the datapad. The Wookiees then commandeered the airspeeder and left the [[Prison/Legends|detention center]]. The incident convinced Chewbacca that his life was too dangerous for Lumpawarrump to stay with him, but he vowed to return home for several weeks and teach his son to [[clench fight]].<ref name="A Forest Apart" />

===Rite of passage===
{{Quote|Father&mdash;I am afraid.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Be afraid. But go forward, all the same.|translated=1|Lumpawarrump and Chewbacca, prior to the final test of Lumpawarrump's hrrtayyk|<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />}}
[[9 ABY/Legends|One year]] later, Organa Solo gave birth to [[Solo twins|twin]] babies: [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]],<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> who were followed by [[Anakin Solo]] [[10 ABY/Legends|another year]] after that.<ref name="Dark Empire II 6">[[Dark Empire II 6|''Dark Empire II'' 6]]</ref> For the following seven years, Chewbacca spent much of his time helping raise and look after the Solo children, and he found less and less time to return home and visit his own family.<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> His absence had a large impact on Lumpawarrump, who grew even more insular and timid. Lumpawarrump still idolized his father, but without Chewbacca there for him to emulate and impress, he had few reasons to seek out trouble or to rush headlong into danger. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], he grew to adult Wookiee height and was deemed ready to undergo his coming-of-age [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|hrrtayyk ceremony]]. Completion of the hrrtayyk would grant him a new name as well as the right to wear a [[baldric]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> With the Solos' blessings, Chewbacca took a leave of absence from his service to their [[Solo family/Legends|family]] in order to return to Kashyyyk and guide his son through the hrrtayyk process. The elder Wookiee took the ''Millennium Falcon''; the Solos hoped that the legendary starship would act as a symbol of the important work he did and would help ease the pain Lumpawarrump felt at his absence.<ref name="Before the Storm" /> When Chewbacca returned home and rushed at his son with a growl of greeting, Lumpawarrump shied away from him in fright. Only then did Chewbacca realize that his absence had prevented Lumpawarrump from discovering his [[rrakktorr]], the eager and defiant strength of a Wookiee's [[Heart/Legends|heart]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

The first task of Lumpawarrump's hrrtayyk was to construct a [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]], a traditional Wookiee projectile weapon. It took him nine days to complete, but the quality of the finished product greatly impressed Chewbacca. Lumpawarrump was then required to hunt [[kroyie]] birds with his new weapon; the younger Wookiee performed adequately at knocking them from the sky. The next challenge, trapping and killing a [[scuttle grazer]], took longer than the construction of the bowcaster and caused Lumpawarrump considerable hardship. His final task was to hunt a predatory [[Katarn/Legends|katarn]] in the [[Well of the Dead]], a location deep within the Shadowlands. Chewbacca guided him there across the [[Rryatt Trail]] from Rwookrrorro into the forest depths and shared stories of his own days hunting the well's dangerous inhabitants. While they walked, Chewbacca asked questions to test Lumpawarrump's knowledge of the reasons why Wookiees hunted katarns, and he cautioned his son patience during the forthcoming challenge. As they reached the Well of the Dead, Lumpawarrump stood petrified, but he proceeded inside after he received encouragement from his father.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

[[File:Chewbaccatyrantstest.jpg|thumb|left|Chewbacca at the time of Lumpawarrump's hrrtayyk]]
After he took about one hundred steps, Lumpawarrump sought out a hiding place and sat with his back to the stump of a Wroshyr tree. He occasionally scanned his surroundings for a katarn, but he was content to stay put and hide himself from any potential predator. Chewbacca covertly followed him in to observe and had no trouble staying hidden from his son, but he was soon interrupted by the arrival of his second cousin [[Freyrr]]. The relative told Chewbacca that Han Solo had been taken prisoner in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] by the [[Duskhan League]], the [[Yevetha]]n government that had recently come into [[Black Fleet Crisis|conflict]] with the New Republic. Chewbacca knew that his duty to Solo superseded his responsibility to his son and immediately decided to mount a rescue attempt. Lumpawarrump was startled when his father called out to him and told him to stop the hunt. It would be considered an embarrassment if Lumpawarrump returned to Rwookrrorro without having completed his hrrtayyk, but Chewbacca felt that his son was not ready and insisted on waiting until he could return and guide Lumpawarrump through the process.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

Lumpawarrump, Chewbacca, Freyrr, and Chewbacca's cousin [[Shoran]] returned to the site of the ''Millennium Falcon'' and met with Mallatobuck, who instructed her son to return to their home and retrieve a food bundle that the tracker [[Kriyystak]] had prepared for Chewbacca's [[Mission to the Koornacht Cluster|mission]]. Lumpawarrump returned to the ship with both the food and his bowcaster, insistent that he be allowed to accompany his father on the mission. Mallatobuck protested, but Chewbacca simply asked his son's reasons why. Lumpawarrump not only wanted an opportunity to earn his baldric and new name, but also to do it at Chewbacca's side and to prove his worth to his father. Chewbacca accepted his son's reasons and allowed Lumpawarrump to join him, Shoran, and Chewbacca's cousins [[Jowdrrl]] and [[Dryanta]] on the rescue mission. Their first stop aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'' was [[Esau's Ridge]], a private smuggler's sanctuary on the planet [[Tholatin]] open only to elite veterans of the trade. Chewbacca sought information on the Koornacht [[Star cluster/Legends|Cluster]] and specialized supplies for the mission, and he ordered Lumpawarrump to remain aboard the ship as he visited the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Formayj]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

It took Formayj several days to acquire the information that Chewbacca requested, and Lumpawarrump grew bored and impatient. He studied the ''Millennium Falcon'' and practiced his fighting skills on Chewbacca's advice. After constantly giving his father pleading looks, he was allowed out of the ship on their fifth day at the ridge. As he and Chewbacca wandered around, Lumpawarrump curiously inspected a Trandoshan's parked starship and received singed fur on his right shoulder from a blaster bolt fired by the angry owner. Chewbacca dragged him to safety and advised his son that Esau's Ridge was not a place where curiosity was rewarded. Two days later, Formayj provided Chewbacca with a navigational map of the Koornacht Cluster, a recording of an address made to the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by the Yevethan [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nil Spaar]], and other documents that provided intelligence on the Yevetha. The information had been channeled to Formayj by the clandestine [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] agency [[Alpha Blue]], which also hoped to see Solo rescued. Chewbacca returned to the ''Millennium Falcon'' and played for the others a forty-hour-old recording of Spaar addressing members of the New Republic on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet's]] [[Channel 81]]. The planet [[N'zoth]] was visible in the background of the recording and became the [[First Wookiee Expeditionary Force|Wookiees']] destination as they lifted off from Esau's Ridge.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

===Finding his rrakktorr===
{{Quote|This is your hrrtayyk.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''I am ready.|translated=1|Chewbacca and Lumpawarrump, while aboard the ''Pride of Yevetha''|<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />}}
Lumpawarrump sat in the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} lower [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]] turret as the ship arrived in the outer reaches of the [[N'zoth system/Legends|N'zoth system]]. Many ships [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the planet; from the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], Chewbacca recognized the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Pride of Yevetha'']] from the recording that the Wookiees had seen; he calculated the orbital data required to [[Precision hyperspace jump|micro-jump]] to within one thousand [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of it. After being relieved from the turret by Dryanta, Lumpawarrump joined his father and Shoran in the cockpit, and the three of them viewed and studied new information sent to them from Formayj: a [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence]] assault plan for an ''Executor''-class Star [[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnought]], complete with marked locations of cell blocks and points on the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] that could effectively be breached. Lumpawarrump grew excited and called Jowdrrl and Dryanta down from the turrets so that they could study the new information too. The ''Millennium Falcon'' then launched a series of [[Firecracker mine/Legends|firecracker mines]] and executed its micro-jump.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

The ship emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] off the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] starboard bow, as the light and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] from the exploding firecracker [[Mine/Legends|mines]] masked the [[Cronau radiation/Legends|cronau radiation]] produced by its jump and flooded the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] of the Yevethan defense grid. Chewbacca took the ''Millennium Falcon'' inside the ''Pride of Yevetha''{{'s}} [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and launched the remaining mines as Jowdrrl and Dryanta fired at Yevethan [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from the quad batteries. Lumpawarrump and Shoran made their way to the ship's hatch as Chewbacca landed on the Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer's]] hull, and Shoran used a [[hull-cutting ring]] to burn through the ''Pride of Yevetha''{{'s}} side and create a way inside. Lumpawarrump gave a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] to his father before he returned to the quad turrets and traded places with Jowdrrl. As Chewbacca and Shoran stormed the Star Destroyer and Jowdrrl guarded the hatch, Lumpawarrump and Dryanta waited in the turrets. They sat bewildered as dozens of Yevethan starfighters flew over their location but did not locate them, and as Jowdrrl reported a group of Yevethan guards who walked past her location without noticing her. The Wookiees were unaware that their presence was being [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|disguised]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by [[Enara]], a [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] adept of the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]] who was being held prisoner along with Solo. Enara also placed an image inside Lumpawarrump's mind: Solo inside a large room, surrounded by beings of various [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

[[File:BigTim-FactFile.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lumpawarrump completed his hrrtayyk while assaulting the ''Pride of Yevetha''.]]
When Shoran was killed by Yevethan guards, Chewbacca contacted the ''Millennium Falcon'' and requested Dryanta's assistance. Lumpawarrump raced to the hatch with several weapons in hand and insisted that he go along, citing the apparent lack of need for quad gunners and his familiarity with the map of the Star Destroyer. Jowdrrl did not argue, and Lumpawarrump led Dryanta through the ''Pride of Yevetha''{{'s}} corridors toward detention block two, where they rendezvoused with Chewbacca. Dryanta picked up Shoran's corpse and returned to the ''Millennium Falcon''. Chewbacca searched for strength in his son's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] before he accepted Lumpawarrump's presence and proceeded toward the next detention block with a command for Lumpawarrump to guard his back. The Wookiees met armed resistance at the entrance to detention block one but blasted their way through the six Yevethan guards; they found no prisoners inside, however, as the vessel's detention blocks had been converted into [[Breedery|breederies]] for Nil Spaar's offspring. Lumpawarrump told his father of the images in his mind, and the vision manifested in Chewbacca's [[Brain/Legends|brain]] as well. He asked Lumpawarrump if he could see any markings in the room, and Lumpawarrump concentrated on the vision before he identified the words "D TWO." The two Wookiees proceeded to the D2 cargo hold.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

Lumpawarrump and Chewbacca fought back-to-back through Yevethan resistance; they cut down groups of tenacious guards whose courage made them easy targets. The Wookiees fired on anything that moved, which reduced the power in their hand blasters to critical levels by the time they reached the cargo hold. Six Yevethan guards who carried [[Personal energy shield/Legends|portable shields]] guarded the entrance, which prompted Chewbacca to give his son several explosive [[Quarrel/Legends|quarrels]] with which to arm his bowcaster. The elder Wookiee gave Lumpawarrump several quick words of advice and rushed toward the doors as Lumpawarrump opened fire. The quarrels destroyed the portable shields and killed three of the guards; the remaining three were critically wounded and were finished off by Chewbacca in bouts of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. Lumpawarrump received a wound in his right leg from the Yevethans' blaster fire but shrugged off the pain and kept firing&mdash;Chewbacca was impressed that his son had met his "katarn" without flinching and that his aim had been true, and he decided that Lumpawarrump had found his rrakktorr and completed his hrrtayyk ceremony. The Wookiees immediately entered the cargo hold, and Lumpawarrump stood guard at the hatchway while Chewbacca spotted Solo among a large group of prisoners and retrieved his friend. Save for Solo and Enara, the prisoners were all in fact Force illusions created by the Fallanassi adept&mdash;they had escaped from the Yevetha before being taken aboard the Star Destroyer, and Enara had protected them by making it appear as though they were still with her. Lumpawarrump cried out as they all vanished from sight and then reappeared with an illusory Solo among them. Enara implored Solo and the Wookiees to flee while she maintained the ruse, and they met the ''Millennium Falcon'' at a nearby flight deck, to which Jowdrrl had piloted the ship after she had been contacted by Chewbacca.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

Lumpawarrump and Chewbacca brought Solo aboard his ship and blasted off under the cover of more firecracker mines. The [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|New Republic Fifth Battle Group]] was stationed nearby, and Chewbacca took the ''Millennium Falcon'' toward the [[Intrepid (Endurance-class)|''Intrepid'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Etahn A'baht]]. The ''Millennium Falcon'' was allowed to dock after Chewbacca's Shyriiwook hails were recognized and deciphered by Luke Skywalker, who was aboard the General's ship. Solo was immediately taken to a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], while Shoran was brought to the ship's morgue. Lumpawarrump limped off the ''Millennium Falcon'' with a second-degree blaster burn on his right calf and joined Skywalker and the other Wookiees in the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical ward]]. They stood by Solo's bedside as he rested in between [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] sessions, and a [[K-1B]] [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] diagnosed Lumpawarrump's injury with the aid of a [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]]. K-1B discovered serious damage to Lumpawarrump's skin and [[Hair/Legends|hair]] cells, as well as to his fat and muscle tissue, and it prescribed a ten-hour session in a bacta tank. Lumpawarrump declined, as he found scarring to be socially desirable, but a protective Chewbacca nevertheless demanded that the medical droid use topical treatments to effectively heal his son. Lumpawarrump was granted a new name after having completed his hrrtayyk ceremony: Lumpawaroo, with Waroo, meaning "Son of courage," as the familiar. Chewbacca prepared the ''Millennium Falcon'' for use in an upcoming New Republic [[Battle of N'zoth|strike]] against N'zoth, but Lumpawaroo was transferred to a [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] with Solo and other noncombatants. The New Republic was victorious, and the threat that the Yevetha posed to the galaxy was ended.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

===Loss of a hero===
{{Quote|Ossus. Why that's practically next door to the CorpSec. No two ways about it, you've gotta join us.''"<br />&laquo;''We promise not to get in the way. Now that the war has ended, Lowie and I will be assuming my father's life debt to you.''&raquo;''<s></s>|quoteend=0|Han Solo, speaking to Luke Skywalker, is interrupted by Lumpawaroo at the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War|<ref name="The Unifying Force" />}}
[[File:Warooandmalla.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Lumpawaroo and Mallatobuck during Chewbacca's funeral]]
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the New Republic's continuing war against the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|remnants]] of the Empire was brought to a close with the signing of a [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace treaty]].<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> In the following years of peace, Chewbacca was able to spend much more time with his family than he had during the hostilities.<ref name="EGTC" /> He remained at Solo's side most of the time, however, and the two were on the planet [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] when its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dobido]] was [[Destruction of Sernpidal|drawn]] toward the planet as part of a [[Yo'gand's Core|military tactic]] employed by an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of religious zealots known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Chewbacca gave his life by helping usher civilians onto the ''Millennium Falcon''&mdash;he was still on Sernpidal's surface as the ship sped away from the exploding planet with the refugees.<ref name="Vector Prime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> In the wake of the tragedy, Lumpawaroo and his cousin [[Lowbacca]] were selected to assume Chewbacca's life debt, continuing their family's commitment to serve Solo until the day he died. Six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, a [[Funeral of Chewbacca|funeral]] was held for the legendary Wookiee outside of Rwookrrorro, and Lumpawaroo was one of several dozen attendees who came to mourn. Friends and family of Chewbacca comprised the twenty-four Wookiees in attendance, who were joined by the Solo family, Luke Skywalker, C-3PO, and R2-D2. The group stood around a circular wooden table as a Wookiee named [[Ralrracheen]] gave a eulogy. Following the [[Funeral/Legends|services]], the table was covered with foodstuffs, and the guests ate and drank while they recalled fond memories of Chewbacca.<ref name="Hero's Trial">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>

Lumpawaroo, Mallatobuck, and several other members of Chewbacca's family approached Solo, who sat alone and dejected. Mallatobuck gave him a bowcaster that Chewbacca had crafted shortly after marrying her, and Lumpawaroo presented him with an animal-hide carry pouch that had once belonged to his father. Jowdrrl and Dryanta intended to arrange a farewell feast for Lumpawaroo and Lowbacca, but when Solo was told that they would be assuming the life debt, he refused the offer. He was not yet ready to replace Chewbacca, who had been his closest friend,<ref name="Hero's Trial" /> and he did not want to risk the lives of Lumpawaroo and Lowbacca and ultimately feel responsible for the deaths of even more friends.<ref name="Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> Mallatobuck and Attichitcuk agreed to grant him more time to grieve,<ref name="Hero's Trial" /> but Lumpawaroo and Lowbacca intended to assume Chewbacca's life debt as soon as circumstances allowed.<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|57|Who's Who in the New Jedi Order}}</ref> The Solos, Skywalker, and the droids left Kashyyyk and continued to aid the New Republic in its [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] against the Yuuzhan Vong, who were intent on conquering the galaxy.<ref name="Hero's Trial" />

The war raged for four years,<ref name="NEC" /> and although the invaders laid siege to much of the galaxy and even [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|took]] Coruscant, Kashyyyk remained relatively untouched.<ref name="The Unifying Force" /> The Wookiee world was turned into a New Republic base [[28 ABY/Legends|three years]] into the war for further defense of the surrounding [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Destiny's Way" /> However, by the time that the invaders were [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|defeated]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], Kashyyyk still stood lush and gleaming. Seven weeks after the war's conclusion, the Solos, as well as Luke Skywalker and his wife [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], again came to Rwookrrorro, and Lumpawaroo joined them and several members of his own family as they returned to the site of Chewbacca's funeral. Solo plunged the [[Anakin Solo's lightsaber|lightsaber]] of his son Anakin, who had [[Mission to Myrkr|died]] [[27 ABY/Legends|two years]] previously, into a fallen tree branch at the site, and everyone afterward returned to Rwookrrorro to enjoy a celebratory feast. Lumpawaroo and Lowbacca decided that the time was right to assume Chewbacca's life debt, and they informed Solo that they would be traveling with him from then on<ref name="The Unifying Force" /> whether he liked it or not.<ref name="NEC" /> Solo attempted to protest but eventually gave in and began to chuckle; everyone present added their voices to the chorus of laughter that now permeated the feast.<ref name="The Unifying Force" /> Lumpawaroo and Lowbacca's service to Solo lasted for less than six years; by [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], they were no longer with him.<ref name="The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

===Aiding the Solos===
{{Quote|This is quite a hike, Waroo.''"<br />"''Twelve hours is a hike. Four days is a kriffing expedition.|Leia and Han Solo, grumbling about Lumpawaroo's chosen route to Council Rock|<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>}}
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], several member worlds broke away from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the New Republic's successor state, and a [[Second Galactic Civil War|war]] erupted between the Alliance and the newly-formed [[Confederation]]. Jacen Solo [[Solo-Niathal coup|seized]] power within the Alliance and became one of its two [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chiefs of State]], and Kashyyyk's [[Rock Council]] convened at the planet's [[Council Rock]] to discuss whether they should lend him their [[Wookiee fleet|fleet]]. Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo, recently declared enemies of the state by their son Jacen, traveled to Kashyyyk to persuade the council not to support the Chief of State. Lumpawaroo acted as their guide during a traditional four-day hike through the Wroshyr trees toward Council Rock. When the trio arrived at the porch which the rock overlooked, the Wookiee leader [[Tojjelnoot]] stood alone atop Council Rock and addressed a large gathering of Wookiees below. Lumpawaroo pushed through the crowd and led the Solos toward the rock, where they were met by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Jae Juun]] and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Tarfang]], two [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service|Galactic Alliance Intelligence]] operatives who were monitoring the Rock Council on behalf of the Alliance.<ref name="Inferno" />

Solo intended to climb the rock and address the council, and Lumpawaroo assured the two guards who protected the path to the top that the Wookiees would want to hear what he had to say. Lumpawaroo also appealed to Solo's longstanding good relationship with the Wookiee people. The guards moved aside to admit Solo, but Juun and Tarfang intervened and reminded them that the Solos were enemies of the Galactic Alliance. The Wookiees conceded the point and demanded the Solos' weapons; the Solos handed them to Lumpawaroo, but Tarfang insisted that aiding them would deem the Wookiees traitors as well. One of the guards kicked the diminutive Tarfang away, and the Ewok responded with a blaster bolt that narrowly missed Lumpawaroo's head. Organa Solo, who was a [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Telekinesis/Legends|retrieved]] Tarfang's blaster with the Force and held him suspended in the air while Solo attempted to physically snatch Juun's blaster away. The Solos were then seized by several Wookiees due to their assault on duly authorized officers of the Galactic Alliance. Lumpawaroo was separated from his allies by a crowd that eagerly encroached, and the Solos were taken to a nearby [[Unidentified Kashyyyk prison|prison]].<ref name="Inferno" />

[[File:BurningOfKashyyk.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Millennium Falcon'', with Lumpawaroo aboard, works to control raging forest fires on Kashyyyk.]]
The Wookiees were sympathetic to the Solos and assigned Lumpawaroo to guard them. When Chewbacca's son took a lunch break after a short time, he told the Solos that he expected them to be in their cell when he returned. He left their weapons unguarded when he departed and fully expected Organa Solo to use the Force to open the lock and return to the Rock Council while he was gone. The Solos did just that and were joined by several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at Council Rock who were led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Luke Skywalker. The [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] had deserted the Galactic Alliance during a recent [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|battle]] at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] due to the increasingly brutal tactics employed by Jacen Solo, and the Chief of State followed them to Kashyyyk&mdash;the [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]] arrived in orbit, and Jacen demanded that the Wookiees turn the Jedi over to him. When Wookiee leaders denied that there were any Jedi onworld, the Fifth [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] began to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombard]] the planet's surface. The attackers were only driven away in the ensuing [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|battle]] due to intervention from several Confederate fleets and of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], allies of the Galactic Alliance who withdrew their support during the battle out of disgust at the burning planet they saw below them. Kashyyyk did not join the Confederation afterward but did strike an informal [[Jedi Coalition|coalition]] with the Jedi and the [[Hapan]]s.<ref name="Inferno" />

The fires on Kashyyyk left behind by the bombardment raged across the Wroshyr forests, and Confederate and volunteer starships worked to control them. Lumpawaroo helped crew the ''Millennium Falcon'' as the Solos planted [[Homing beacon/Legends|beacons]] throughout the forest. Several days after the battle, Solo flew the ship while Organa Solo planted the beacons, and Lumpawaroo stood ready at the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} [[Docking ring/Legends|docking ring]] to bring her back aboard after each beacon was planted. The beacons were planted in lines across the planet and fired upon by the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] of Confederate [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]]; the surgical strikes caused precise columns of forest to ignite. The volunteer vessels then controlled the blazes with fire-snuffing foam. When they were extinguished, the char left in their wake checked the advancing wildfires caused by the Fifth Fleet, which, thus contained, would eventually die out. After Organa Solo planted the final beacon of one line, Lumpawaroo was helping her aboard when the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|artificial gravity]] failed and slammed them both against a bulkhead.<ref name="Fury" />

When Organa Solo heard the laughter of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]], an old nemesis of hers, she told Lumpawaroo to make his way to the cockpit and protect her husband. Lumpawaroo leaped through the high [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] while Organa Solo ignited her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and hunted for Rar. Solo was aware of the Dark Jedi's presence and had turned off the artificial gravity to stop an attempt of hers to kill him; when Lumpawaroo reached the cockpit, Solo immediately told him to leave and go protect Organa Solo. The Confederate cruiser ''[[Lillibanca]]'' began to fire on their beacons at that instant, and Solo's evasive maneuvers caused Lumpawaroo to tumble backward through the cockpit access corridor. Organa Solo slowed his descent with the Force as he hurtled past the [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] bay, where she had [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] Rar in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. After a bulkhead broke his fall, Organa Solo blocked a strike by Rar that was aimed at the Wookiee's prone form; Lumpawaroo quickly recovered and fired his bowcaster at the Dark Jedi. Organa Solo deflected it with her blade, however, having been unable to [[Force sense/Legends|find]] Rar's presence in the Force&mdash;where it should have been was merely a duplicate of Lumpawaroo's presence.<ref name="Fury" />

Lumpawaroo ceased firing on Organa Solo's instructions. When her opponent began to only fight defensively, Rar fled the engineering bay and disappeared from the ship entirely. Lumpawaroo and Organa Solo both pursued her before they realized that she had vanished. When the ''Millennium Falcon'' landed in a hangar in the [[Maitell Base]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], it was searched by Jaina Solo and her friends [[Jagged Fel]] and [[Zekk]], who found no trace of Rar. The Solos later discovered that Rar had projected her presence from across the galaxy using the [[Force phantom]] technique with the use of Lumpawaroo's presence as an anchor&mdash;Rar's use of the arcane [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] technique meant that any harm caused to her phantom would have been harm caused to Lumpawaroo as well.<ref name="Fury" />

The Solos remained on Kashyyyk for some time to perform more firefighting missions, and several days after the Force phantom incident, Lumpawaroo received a package that was addressed to Han Solo. He performed a routine scan on the metal case and found nothing harmful before he gave it to Solo, who was surprised to receive it. The package turned out to be [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and [[Crushgaunt/Legends|crushgaunts]] sent to Solo by his old enemy Boba Fett, intended as a sympathy gift for the monster that Solo's son had become and a weapon with which to kill Jacen if the need arose. Solo refused the gift and passed it on to Fel, who had formed a [[Alema Rar Task Force|task force]] with Jaina and Zekk to hunt down Rar. Fel was able to use the crushgaunts to kill Rar while [[Skirmish at The Home|battling]] her on an [[The Home|asteroid]],<ref name="Fury" /> and both the war and Jacen's reign of terror were brought to an end when Jaina [[Battle of Uroro Station|killed]] her [[Twin/Legends|twin]] brother [[41 ABY|weeks later]].<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Our son is already trying to be you. That is the problem. What you must do, my mate, is teach him to be himself.|translated=1|Mallatobuck, to Chewbacca|<ref name="A Forest Apart" />}}
[[File:Storytime.jpg|thumb|left|200px|As a child, Lumpawarrump enjoyed hearing tales of his father's adventures.]]
As a young Wookiee, Lumpawarrump was a mischievous,<ref name="Monster Ships">{{InsiderCite|74|Wasaka Berries and Monster Ships: Star Wars Storybook 101|Wasaka Berries and Monster Ships: ''Star Wars'' Storybook 101}}</ref> adventurous boy<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" /> who loved to play with toys, eat Wookiee-ookiees, and watch [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] videos. He was very fond of his stuffed bantha but was not at all fond of cleaning dishes. The presence of Imperials in his home on Life Day greatly distressed him, and when an Imperial technician came too close to him, he responded by biting the man's fingers.<ref name="Holiday Special" /> The young Lumpawarrump was in awe of his father and enjoyed hearing stories of Chewbacca's adventures;<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" /> early on, he came to idolize his father, a fascination that lasted for years.<ref name="A Forest Apart" /> When he entered the Shadowlands to gather wasaka berries for Chewbacca's 200th birthday, Lumpawarrump hoped that he could be as brave as his father and pretended to be adventuring on a far-off planet. He ignored the fright that enveloped him while he searched, firm in his belief that Chewbacca would never be conquered by fear, and he was devastated when he was unable to collect any berries. Lumpawarrump was cheered up immensely when his father told him that he was a hero due to his having pressed on in the face of fear.<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" /> When several Imperials searched his home during the Life Day of 1 ABY, Lumpawarrump used his mini-transmitter to trick them into leaving.<ref name="Holiday Special" />

As a teenager, Lumpawarrump tried to emulate Chewbacca rather than assert his own identity. He often played under the name "Lumpacca" in the hologame "Galactic Rebels" and boasted to his friends that he was as strong as his father. While chasing a burglar through the depths of Coruscant, he proceeded exactly how he thought Chewbacca would and was very ashamed when his plans did not succeed, feeling that he had let his father down and that he was not as strong or as independent as Chewbacca. He lost some of his energy when Chewbacca scolded him but gained it back whenever he received praise from his father.<ref name="A Forest Apart" /> Although Chewbacca was not able to visit his family on Kashyyyk very often over the following eight years, Lumpawarrump was still deeply anxious for his father's approval during his hrrtayyk ceremony in 16 ABY. He insisted on accompanying Chewbacca to the Koornacht Cluster in that year to rescue Han Solo, eager for the chance to pass his hrrtayyk at his father's side. Lumpawarrump knew that death possibly awaited him, but the idea of failing his father was a fear that loomed larger in his mind. By this point in his life, Lumpawarrump felt the heavy burden of being the son of a legendary warrior and desperately wanted to prove his worth to both Chewbacca and to his community in Rwookrrorro.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

When in Chewbacca's presence, Lumpawarrump sought praise only from his father and ignored instructions issued to him by Mallatobuck. He was not rebellious toward his mother when at home, however, and he never yelled at her.<ref name="A Forest Apart" /> He was considerate of her feelings and did not tell her about his plans to gather wasaka berries in the Shadowlands so as to not hurt her, as she had expressly forbidden him from going. Lumpawarrump was additionally very fond of Solo, the man to whom Chewbacca owed a life debt. He loved to hear stories from Solo whenever the smuggler visited Kashyyyk<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" /> and believed Solo to be just as brave as his father.<ref name="A Forest Apart" /> Solo in turn cared deeply for the young Wookiee,<ref name="The Wookiee Storybook" /> having found the<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> chunky baby<ref name="EGTC" /> cute right from his birth.<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> Solo thought of all of Lumpawarrump's family as his own,<ref name="Holiday Special" /> and in 40 ABY, he mused that Lumpawaroo and Jacen Solo could have one day inherited the ''Millennium Falcon'' from him had Jacen not fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Fury" />

Lumpawarrump's early adventure in the Shadowlands was responsible for a great deal of trauma that caused him to start staying close to his home and the Rwookrrorro nursery ring.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> When he asserted to other young Wookiees that he was as strong as his father, his bluff was called and he was beaten up.<ref name="A Forest Apart" /> Mallatobuck and Attichitcuk did not encourage him to participate in the nursery ring's rough unstructured play, and as such, Lumpawarrump did not develop the typically fearless fighting style of Wookiee males. Without any close friends,<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> he grew insular and soft-spoken and rarely left home.<ref name="A Forest Apart" /> Chewbacca felt guilty about not being able to be at home and instruct his son in the ways of the Wookiees, but Lumpawarrump did not begrudge his father.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> He dreamed of his father's adventures while he stayed at home, and he overcame his timidity while in Chewbacca's presence in an effort to impress him.<ref name="A Forest Apart" />

[[File:Three_generations_of_Rwook.png|thumb|right|200px|Family and honor were very important to Lumpawaroo.]]
The lack of a present father figure to teach Lumpawarrump Wookiee ways nearly spelled doom for him during his misadventure on Coruscant: while chasing the burglars, he constantly rushed headlong into danger without considering that real life was dissimilar to "Galactic Rebels." Lumpawarrump often ran right into his enemy's line of fire, thinking only of being as brave as his father.<ref name="A Forest Apart" /> Although he had neither Chewbacca nor any good friends to test himself against in clench fighting, Lumpawarrump did have raw talent. He constructed an excellent bowcaster during his hrrtayyk ceremony and proved adept at shooting kroyie birds with it. He did not excel at hunting a scuttle grazer, however, and while in the Well of the Dead, he chose a hiding spot that had a large blind spot&mdash;he did not detect the presence of Chewbacca, Freyrr, or a katarn, all of whom came close to him in the well. Lumpawarrump's rrakktorr bloomed late in his heart; while in the Well of the Dead, he was terrified of the katarns that awaited him.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />

Lumpawarrump finally found his rrakktorr when his talent and his eagerness to prove himself manifested in displays of measured skill and fearlessness aboard the ''Pride of Yevetha''. He and his father fought back-to-back through [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of Yevethan guards, and when a blaster bolt struck the younger Wookiee's leg, he met it without flinching or uttering a sound of complaint. Lumpawarrump maintained a steady aim, impressing his father and completing his hrrtayyk. He fought like an experienced warrior and even joked with Chewbacca in the midst of a dangerous situation. Proud of his accomplishment, he afterward wished to keep the scar on his leg.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> By 40 ABY, Lumpawaroo was clever, lanky, and a good and powerful warrior who had golden-brown fur and shades of Chewbacca in his face. He was strong and agile and was able to leap through the ''Millennium Falcon'' after its artificial gravity was turned off,<ref name="Fury" /> even if he was still about 100 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] too light to bellow and demand his way through the Rock Council.<ref name="Inferno" /> At that time, Lumpawaroo's Shyriiwook speech often emerged as moans and groans when things were not going well for him. In addition to being able to speak Shyriiwook, Lumpawaroo could understand [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Fury" /><ref name="Inferno" />

As with many Wookiees, family and honor were very important to Lumpawaroo.<ref name="Inferno" /> He insisted on continuing Chewbacca's life debt to Solo after his father's death, and when Solo delayed it in order to fully grieve, Lumpawaroo did not allow himself to forget about it.<ref name="Hero's Trial" /> After the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War, he and Lowbacca intended to continue the life debt regardless of whether or not Solo wished it.<ref name="NEC" /> Lumpawaroo was still very dedicated to Solo and his wife in 40 ABY when he guided them to Council Rock and when he helped them break out of prison. The latter incident was done according to his own code of honor.<ref name="Inferno" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Creation===
{{Quote|Star Wars' first foray into the world of TV was unforgettable for all the wrong reasons. See the Wookiee homeworld for the first time! Meet Chewie's family! What could possibly go wrong?|[[Star Wars Insider 106|''Star Wars Insider'' 106]] takes a retrospective look at ''The Star Wars Holiday Special''|<ref name="Bad Feeling" />}}
The character that would eventually be called Lumpawaroo<ref name="Tyrant's Test" /> was conceived by [[George Lucas]] in [[1978]] as one of the principal characters of ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', a television [[Wikipedia:Variety show|variety show]] that was [[Wikipedia:Spin-off (media)|spun off]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']], Lucas's film of the [[1977|previous year]].<ref name="Comedy Hour">{{WebCite|url=http://www.vanityfair.com/magazine/2008/12/star_wars_special200812|text=The Han Solo Comedy Hour! (page 1 of 3)|work=Vanity Fair|archivedate=20081223164238}}</ref> Chewbacca was one of ''Star Wars''{{'s}} main characters,<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> and Lucas crafted a plot for the ''Holiday Special'' that centered and focused entirely on his family.<ref name="Comedy Hour" /> He named all three new Wookiee characters, christening Chewbacca's son "Lumpy."<ref name="Comedy Hour 2">{{WebCite|url=http://www.vanityfair.com/magazine/2008/12/star_wars_special200812?currentPage=2|text=The Han Solo Comedy Hour! (page 2 of 3)|work=Vanity Fair|archivedate=20110531032415}}</ref> The [[Wikipedia:Screenwriter|writers]] and [[Wikipedia:Television producer|producers]] of the special added [[Wikipedia:Sketch comedy|comedy skits]], [[Wikipedia:Number (music)|musical numbers]], and characters that spoke Basic to the plot, which turned the finished product into a variety show typical of 1970s television but still used the Wookiee family as its focal point.<ref name="Comedy Hour" /> A "Wookiee Bible" providing backstory on Lumpy and his family was written by representatives of [[Lucasfilm]] and given to the special's various [[Wikipedia:Television director|directors]]; [[Steve Binder]], the final director to come aboard the project, had no direct contact with Lucas and relied on the bible to accurately direct the Wookiees according to Lucas's vision.<ref name="Binder official interview">{{SWArchive|url=movies/saga/20081117.html|text=Holiday Special: Script and Directors}}</ref>

[[File:Lumpyconcepts.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Concept art of Lumpy by Joe Johnston]]
The ''Holiday Special''{{'s}} [[Wikipedia:Screenplay|script]] states that Lumpy's full name is "Lumwarrump" and calls the character a "plump, feisty 10-year old."<ref name="Bad Feeling" /> The final draft of the script sees Lumpy, his mother, and his grandfather spend the majority of the ''Holiday Special'' awaiting Chewbacca's Life Day homecoming,<ref name="Holiday Special" /> but in early story treatments, Chewbacca arrives home near the beginning of the story and interacts with Lumpy. Upset about not being able to receive a Life Day gift immediately, Lumpy stows away aboard a trader's ship and ends up in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He is then discovered by the trader and taken to a Kashyyyk-bound vessel called the ''Starship Musica'', where he meets an entertainer, written to be played by [[Wikipedia:Actor|actress]] [[Wikipedia:Raquel Welch|Raquel Welch]], who is on assignment from the Empire to sabotage the ship. Purportedly singing Lumpy a song about how a starship operates, she dances her way into the ship's control room and damages the controls. Chewbacca then takes a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to the ''Starship Musica'' and pilots it safely to Kashyyyk's surface, where a Life Day celebration ensues.<ref name="story treatment">{{WebCite|url=http://starwarsholidayspecial.com/text/story_treatment.htm|text=Story Treatment, 05/31/78|work=The Star Wars Holiday Special|archivedate=20101129222958}}</ref>

Concept art by [[Joe Johnston]] developed for the ''Holiday Special'' depicts Lumpy and Chewbacca interacting with an Environmental Transporter machine that can virtually take them to different locations across the galaxy.<ref name="Bad Feeling" /><ref name="Concept art">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsholidayspecial.com/photos/art.htm|text=Star Wars Holiday Special|work=The Star Wars Holiday Special|archivedate=20171227030028}}</ref> A painting by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] features Lumpy viewing a hologram of a [[Wikipedia:Gnome|Gnomish]] figure that resembles [[Wikipedia:Father Christmas|Father Christmas]].<ref name="Bad Feeling" /> Both concepts went unused in the finished product of the ''Holiday Special''.<ref name="Holiday Special" /> [[Wikipedia:Action figure|Action figures]] of Chewbacca's family developed by the [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] toy company also went unproduced, although prototypes were constructed. Lumpy's figure was built around a [[Wikipedia:Fisher-Price|Fisher-Price]] family toy.<ref name="prototypes">{{SWArchive|url=vault/collecting/20090402b.html|text=Prototype Gallery: Creature Cantina, Rocket Fett, and Holiday Wookiees}}</ref> An article published in ''Tomart's Action Figure Digest'' claims that the figures were not ultimately produced due to the selling window having been too small.<ref name="merchandise">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsholidayspecial.com/merchandise/prototypes.htm|text=Merchandise: Prototype Toys|work=The Star Wars Holiday Special|archivedate=20031204012210}}</ref>

===Portrayal===
{{Quote|I probably auditioned with ten other people, I was the only female that I'm aware of that auditioned for the part. I was surprised, being a female, that I got it but I was thrilled with it. I just loved doing Lumpy.|Patty Maloney|<ref name="Lumpy speaks">{{SWArchive|url=movies/saga/20081119a.html|text=Holiday Special: Lumpy Speaks}}</ref>}}
